value.rationale: Extends the exact-mean analysis of a current randomized numerical linear-algebra benchmark to a full fixed-instance coefficient distribution, strict every-threshold reliability order, sharp higher moments and tail constants. It quantifies what expected-error-only analysis cannot and remains informative at dimensions where the mean or higher moments diverge; not an arbitrary slice or mere notation change.
